title: The dev app is rebuilt after every task again
goal: After each task lands, the app the user playtests with is supposed to be rebuilt so they are never looking at a stale build. That has stopped happening: the step fails before it starts, so the user keeps whatever build they last opened, however many tasks have shipped since.
notes: queue/bin/refresh-dev-app.sh line 59 is `bundle() { PHOTONZ_ALLOW_DEV_BUILD=1 Scripts/build-app.sh }` — bash needs a semicolon or newline before the closing brace, so the whole script dies with "syntax error: unexpected end of file" and nothing runs. Landed in 09ae00e3. Hit on 2026-09-07 by the Appearance/Effects run, which therefore left the dev app stale. `bash -n queue/bin/refresh-dev-app.sh` reproduces it in a second; add that check to whatever guards the queue scripts so a broken one-liner cannot ship again.
acceptance: Running the refresh step by hand succeeds and reports which bundle it rebuilt
A task run that changes code under Sources leaves the dev app rebuilt, and running if it was running before
The app the user has open is never left quit by a refresh that failed halfway
